item.title: Serious health and safety concerns and a dumping ground, 8th August
item.description:
Hi, this abandoned trailer has been parked outside of 123 Plum Lane SE18 3AG on the street opposite the busy primary school since September 2025. It has been reported in October 2025 and March 2026. Nothing has been done. It is only stopped by a couple of bricks on a steep slope which places serious safety concerns. To make it worse, people have started to use it as a dumping ground for the rubbish. Please can you remove it from our street urgently? Thank you!

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Plum Lane, Plumstead
Report on FixMyStreet
